regions.today: Dry to start with some sunny spells. Cloud will increase through the afternoon with rain and drizzle developing in the evening. Light to moderate southwest winds will back southeast and strengthen moderate to fresh. Highest temperatures of 11 to 13 degrees.
regions.tonight: Wet and windy weather associated with Storm Austen will bring spells of heavy rain overnight with fresh to strong northwesterly winds. Lowest temperatures of 6 to 8 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Wet and windy to start but the rain will clear early on giving way to sunshine and scattered showers. Highest temperatures of 8 to 10 degrees in fresh and gusty northwest winds, easing moderate towards the evening.
